rationale: Aayush is building AI applications through Outbound AI with a focus on healthcare-ai, while Hrushikesh brings deep operational expertise from his role as a supply chain analyst at Sharp Healthcare. They could explore how AI might address real supply chain and operations challenges in healthcare—combining Aayush's technical foundation (Python, TypeScript) with Hrushikesh's domain knowledge of healthcare operations.
intro_message: Hrushikesh Jadhav, meet Aayush Gandhi — Aayush is a UC Berkeley student and founder working on AI applications in healthcare, and you have hands-on supply chain experience at a major healthcare system that could inform where AI could have real operational impact.
